test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 07 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster and the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter-cluster.

COMPLEX : OCXELPM :: BALANCE : ABECNAL :: AIRLINE : ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/95e8d7f18fcf2b6801af6bc9d1c6a9b0f0dbfacea23a7bd8da0f6df6b5ef99f5.png] 

The logic followed here is:

COMPLEX is coded as OCXELPM

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/109eefc2a5bdb350adf584281869dae7a3b47420355f36543acc9edf06701e53.png] 

BALANCE is coded as ABECNAL

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4c8c89f6bf40ea1e7c22db830096931d148b008789524545a8085a45a17a407d.png] 

Similarly, AIRLINE is coded as,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0e6f438d27b3a3e8b3515e27778ffd53c225503096ed50fc35869c5c141f2c07.png] 

So, 'AIRLINE' will be coded as 'IAENILR'.

Hence, the correct answer is __**IAENILR**__**.**
